# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

This is the `test1` repository. Keep this file updated as the project evolves so Copilot has accurate context.

## General Guidelines

- Write clear, readable, and well-structured code.
- Follow the existing code style and conventions already present in the repository.
- Prefer simple, straightforward solutions over complex ones.
- Add comments only where the intent is not immediately obvious from the code itself.

## When Suggesting Code

- Make the smallest change necessary to address the task.
- Avoid introducing unnecessary dependencies.
- Ensure new code is consistent with any existing patterns in the codebase.
- Validate edge cases and error conditions.

## Repository Context

- This repository is set up for efficient AI-assisted development.
- See `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root for additional project instructions used by Claude Code.
